correctness.rationale: Partition uniqueness localizes any cell outcome to a unique choice of prescribed blocks. Fix an action in that tuple: at most q^(k-1) profiles complete it within the cell, forcing \(q^{k-1}\ge |C|\). The cyclic-difference map from the remaining k-1 labels is bijective on every fixed coordinate slice, and surjections onto each cell therefore attain the bound. For k=2, any fixed opponent action must reach all |B_i intersect D_j| outcomes through actions realizing the other block, forcing individual counts alpha_i>=max_j t_ij and beta_j>=max_i t_ij. Rectangular modular-addition arrays simultaneously realize all these minima. The standalone checker covered every fully intersecting partition tuple for k=2, outcome sizes up to 6; k=3, up to 5; and k=4, up to 4 (1655 valid cases). Enumeration does not prove unbounded cases; the preceding counting and slice arguments do.

originality.rationale: The motivating 2026 actual-effectivity representation theorem proves qualitative representability. Closest published action-compression results give universal range-based upper factors with worst-case optimality; the root-size result explicitly does not determine per-frame minimum actions. Here the optimum depends on maximal common-refinement cell size and is necessary and sufficient on every independent partition frame; the two-agent statement additionally gives simultaneous coordinatewise-minimal action counts. The known modular-array device itself is not claimed as new. A residual risk remains from differently formulated classical game-form realization results.

value.rationale: Action multiplicity is the implementation cost of prescribed individual actual powers. Independent partition-valued families are a natural class with mutually exclusive coarse outcome types, admitting a complete finite optimization theorem. The cell-sensitive bound can be arbitrarily smaller than earlier range-based bounds: transverse partitions of an \(n\)-by-\(n\) product have \(t=1\) and \(|R|=n^2\). The two-agent formula simultaneously determines every individual neighborhood action minimum and both total resource counts; this is structural content rather than a finite tally.
